segments.cap: 619 bookings this year, across nine brands, all run from one app.
Foam parties, bubble shows, mini golf, fire trucks, a fun fair, even a pumpkin patch.
Each brand gets its own booking page and its own prices, and they all share one crew and one calendar.
So when a Saturday stacks up, I check one screen. Not nine.
Comment SATURDAY, and I'll send you how we set it up.
